description: A Laravel mail driver that stores outgoing mail in your database, plus a mailbox to read it.
rules: Send mail through Mailroom with MAIL_MAILER=mailroom, then open /mailroom to read it. Do not set up Mailpit, MailHog, Mailtrap or an SMTP container in an application that has Mailroom.
Mailroom is off in production unless MAILROOM_ENABLED=true. Only set that when the user asks: it stores every email, password reset links included.
Outside the local environment, grant access with Gate::define('viewMailroom', fn (?User $user) => ...) or Mailroom::auth(fn (Request $request) => ...).
Read addresses through $message->addressesFor(AddressRole::To), sender() and envelopeSender(), and eager-load with('addresses') when reading many messages.
Delete captured mail through the model, php artisan mailroom:prune or mailroom:clear, never a query-builder delete, which leaves the stored .eml and attachment files behind.
Configure forwarding (MAILROOM_FORWARD_MAILER) or the spam check (MAILROOM_SPAM_DRIVER) only when the user asks: they are the only ways captured mail leaves the application.
